# dsh-local-ocr
English | 简体中文
An independent local OCR library and DeepSeek Harness tool plugin for macOS and Windows. It does not
modify `deepseek-harness`, own a cache, or decide when OCR should run.
The native adapter uses `@napi-rs/system-ocr`, which exposes macOS system OCR and Windows Media OCR
through one Node.js API. Its native work credits `win-ocr-rs` and `mac-system-ocr`.
